title: Saiyuki
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A loose retelling of Journey to the West. In the land of Shangri-La, a 'Minus Wave' from forbidden science-magic experiments aimed at reviving the Ox-Demon King drives youkai mad and breaks the peace between youkai and humans. Short-tempered Buddhist high priest Genjo Sanzo, sent west by heavenly figures, travels with three youkai companions, Goku, Gojyo and Hakkai, facing assassins and their own pasts.
life_message: Loyalty among flawed companions and living by one's own will matter more than piety or fixed roles.

content.note: Reviewer calls it 'excessively violent' with mature themes (MU review 434); MU Violence category; gunfights and youkai battles.

folkways.japan: Its irreverent priest and youkai companions rework a Chinese classic through Japanese youkai lore and shoujo-magazine character drama.

delivery.evidence: MU reviewer stresses characters, action and dark tone and names no explicit moral (MU review 434).
delivery.note: The review describes a character-driven action story whose values come through the companions' loyalty rather than stated lessons.

winners_losers: The four companions' loyalty and self-will are shown with sympathy; those behind the Minus Wave experiments are the antagonists.
